summary: Full frontend regression after site restructure into multi-page URLs (/, /home/, /why/, /programs/, /apply/, /admin.html). All 10 requested test scenarios PASS: landing gate + Enter link → /home/; nav tabs are real <a href> with correct active class on each of the 4 pages; logo → /; all pages load with site.css + logos (no 404s except unrelated cloudflare rum); persona selector on /home/ swaps message text when clicking data-persona cards (verified professional → 'AI changed the game...'); Programs modules expand, level2-toggle-mkt/hr expand with aria-expanded flip, spec tabs (mkt-spec-btn) switch panels, Signature link → /apply/, Accountant card exists with no Level 2; Apply form POST → success 'You\'re on the list.'; Workshop modal opens, POST → 'Your seat is reserved.'; window.Lenis & __lenis undefined (native scroll); footer links Find Your Chapter → /home/#persona and Apply → /apply/; Admin CMS login with 'walkthetalk' works, applications=6, bookings=4, tab switching works, both CSV downloads produce the-academy-applications-2026-09-03.csv and the-academy-workshop-bookings-2026-09-03.csv. Outcomes NOT in nav (only Home/Why/Programs/Apply Now).
critical_code_review_comments: Note (not a bug): topbar has fixed/sticky positioning that intercepts pointer events in Playwright when clicking .mkt-spec-btn without force=True — for automated tests use force=True or scroll-margin-top; real users are unaffected because natural cursor click coordinates land on the button.

public/index.html (landing gate) and per-page files (/home/index.html, /why/index.html, /programs/index.html, /apply/index.html) share nav+footer markup — consider server-side includes or a small build step to DRY the ~40 lines of duplicated topbar/footer across 5 HTML files.
